sources.passage: V4.1-Flash is now live on the DeepSeek API with native multimodal support. Set your model to deepseek-flash. V4-Flash & V4-Flash-Vision-Exp are retired. For compatibility, deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp temporarily route to V4.1-Flash. Starting at 04:00 UTC on Sept 14, 2026, all deepseek-v4-pro requests will route to V4.1-Flash at V4.1-Flash rates. This will continue until V4.1-Pro launches.
sources.limitations: API announcement; it does not identify which third-party apps use any route or establish a web/app-chat change.
sources.additionalPassage: News September 10, 2026. Introducing DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: smarter, faster, more efficient. Introducing the smallest model in our new architecture family, with native visual understanding.
sources.additionalPassageLocator: https://deepseek.com/en/news/deepseek-v4-1-flash/ — visible news date, headline and opening bullet

sources.passage: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now available on AI Gateway with native image understanding.
